reason: Cutting the cargo mesh with the service tool may make a support for the growing potato stems, which matches the current goal.
expectation: I expect to make some kind of support or trellis, though I don't know its exact form.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but I want to address the potato goal first.

effect: The mesh and tool made a plant support cage, which looks ready to fit to the potato trough.
reaction: The result matched my expectation, which is satisfying.
reason: Fitting the cage to the potato trough seems like the natural next step toward giving the stems room.
expectation: I expect the cage to support the potato plants as they grow, though I'm unsure exactly how it will be fitted.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but I want to finish the current potato goal first.

effect: The cage completed the potato goal, and the new goal is to taste the first harvest.
reaction: The reminder that the tubers are still developing makes the wait feel tangible.
reason: Harvesting the ready lettuce is the only numbered action and fits the new goal.
expectation: I expect to cut the lettuce for a first harvest, though it may need another step before tasting.

effect: The scissors produced fresh lettuce leaves, ready for the galley.
reaction: Harvesting the crop planted earlier feels satisfying.
reason: Taking the leaves to the galley is the only numbered action and seems suited to tasting the harvest.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce in the galley, though I don't know exactly what will happen.

effect: The lettuce became the first fresh meal, completing the harvest goal and the chapter.
reaction: The green smell against the barren view is a vivid payoff for the earlier planting.

mostWorthwhile.text: The first fresh meal made the harvest feel tangible through its smell and the view outside.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was straightforward and produced no further detail on its own.

surprise.text: The potato support was finished while the tubers were still only a promise, emphasizing how much longer that crop needs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the cage, harvest scissors, and galley all had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see the potatoes develop and how life in the cabin changes, though this chapter's actions were mostly predictable.
